capability_summary: The official V2 page documents a static-image URL workflow: submit one image task, then query for a result URL. It documents fixed-parameter groups for face reshaping, eye size, slim nose and teeth whitening. Product material also describes batch scenarios, but the V2 request document explicitly says one resource per task; this project must orchestrate a batch as multiple independently checked tasks, not claim a multi-image request.

face_shape.execution_note: Documented request fields are candidate evidence only. Do not expose them as active runtime controls until an authorized live smoke validates their effect and returned artifact.

eyes.execution_note: The V2 document proves an eye-size field, not the other eye sub-features listed here as unverified.

nose.execution_note: The official V2 label is 瘦鼻. It must not be generalized to every nose geometry operation.

mouth.execution_note: The V2 document currently evidences teeth whitening only; it does not evidence mouth-shape or lip-thickness execution.

output.result_retention: Official service terms say a completed media task result may be released/destroyed; no exact TTL is published for this V2 API.

auth.onboarding_credential_note: The product overview separately mentions obtaining AK&SK through the console, while the V2 APIKey document and its sample use a Bearer API key. Treat the operation-specific Bearer API key as the candidate request contract; confirm the account/onboarding relationship with Volcengine before any live call.
auth.allow_live_switch: --allow-live plus a configured deployment secret and every admission gate

privacy.outbound_mechanism: A remote image URL is supplied in resource_list to Volcengine's asynchronous service.
privacy.service_license_territory: China mainland under the currently cited intelligent-experience service terms unless otherwise agreed in writing.
privacy.data_processing_region: pending_vendor_confirmation; service license territory is not proof of physical processing region.
privacy.provider_retention: Input retention is not stated in the V2 API document. Task-result release/destruction is mentioned in service terms, but the exact TTL is not published.
privacy.model_improvement_or_training: The cited service terms contain limited anonymous service-improvement language, but do not establish a V2-specific no-training/no-retention guarantee. Treat as unverified for this product.
privacy.user_consent_scope: A Tencent consent does not cover Volcengine. Obtain separate provider/outbound consent before any live image request; customer must have lawful rights and consent for uploaded material.

cost.unit: 创点 (official product overview); exact V2 per-image/public price not found
cost.budget_policy: block when a verified estimate exceeds the current plan budget
cost.currency_source: Official overview says to purchase creator points through business/support; the SDK annual price table is a different product surface and must not be used as this API's unit price.

latency.note: The sample's polling values are implementation examples, not an SLA or latency commitment.

batch.supported_claim: The product overview names batch retouching scenarios, but the V2 interface document says each task supports only one resource_list image.

failure_policy.retry: No automatic retry until provider error taxonomy, task polling, timeout and idempotency behavior are verified.
failure_policy.result_validation: Decode the returned artifact, verify target-face isolation/recomposition and run local verification before presenting the result as usable.

source.source_status: official_documentary_evidence_reviewed_2026-08-30; no target-account credential, billing screen, data-processing addendum, live request or result receipt reviewed
